durations_min.note: Estimated average real-time game length, used only to block out time. MLB 165 = 2:45 (2026 average reported by a third-party site, unverified; MLB 2025 nine-inning average 2:38 per lines.com citing MLB pace data). NFL 192 = 3:12 (2024 average, lines.com). NCAAF 207 = 3:27 (2024 FBS average, measuringexpert.com). Halftime is inside the NFL and NCAAF figures (NFL halftime ~12-13 min; NCAAF 20 min).
